tool.name: Perseus Extract Features
tool.description: extract lineage-aware features from a Kraken2 output file
tool.command:
#set $taxonomy_db_path = $taxonomy_db.fields.path
## The data table points at a directory holding taxa.sqlite (and, when ETE3 has ## already built it, its taxa.sqlite.traverse.pkl cache). Link both into the job ## directory instead of copying: a full NCBI database is hundreds of MB and this ## tool runs once per sample. ETE3 opens the database read-write, but its query ## path only reads; the one write path is update_taxonomy_database, which ETE3 ## runs only for a database older than its DB_VERSION (2 in both ete3 and ete4). ## The version column of the data table records that schema version, so an ETE3 ## that ever bumps it leaves the mismatch visible there, and the database is then ## rebuilt with the ETE3 Setup Taxonomy Database tool. mkdir -p taxonomy_db && ln -s '$taxonomy_db_path/taxa.sqlite' taxonomy_db/taxa.sqlite && if [ -e '$taxonomy_db_path/taxa.sqlite.traverse.pkl' ]; then ln -s '$taxonomy_db_path/taxa.sqlite.traverse.pkl' taxonomy_db/taxa.sqlite.traverse.pkl; fi && mkdir -p feature_shards && perseus extract '$kraken_input' feature_shards taxonomy_db --min-tax-kmers $min_tax_kmers --threads "\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && test -f feature_shards/manifest.json && tar -cf '$feature_shards_output' -C feature_shards .

param.label: Minimum taxonomic k-mers per sequence
param.help: Sequences with fewer taxonomic k-mers than this are excluded from the output (0 = include all sequences)

tool.help:
## What it does
Extracts a lineage-aware feature matrix from a Kraken2 output file and writes it as a directory of sharded files, which the **Perseus Filter Kraken2 Output** tool consumes together with the same Kraken2 output file to compute per-rank confidence probabilities.
The output of this tool is a single tar archive containing the shard directory; use it directly as the *Feature shards* input of **Perseus Filter Kraken2 Output**.
### Inputs
- **Kraken2 output file**: the per-read classification file produced by Kraken2, i.e. the file with the columns classified/unclassified, sequence ID, taxonomy ID, sequence length and the k-mer LCA mapping. The Kraken2 *report* file is not accepted. - **Minimum taxonomic k-mers per sequence**: sequences with less taxonomic evidence than this are dropped before the feature matrix is built; the default of 0 keeps every sequence. - **ETE3 taxonomy database**: an ETE3 NCBI taxonomy database installed by the **ETE3 Setup Taxonomy Database** data manager.
## About Perseus
Perseus is a post-processing framework for refining Kraken2 taxonomic classifications, with a focus on long-read metagenomics (PacBio HiFi, ONT).
